basis: Benign histiocytic proliferation confined to skin, with characteristic papules; no systemic organ disease.
Autoinflammatory sterile abscesses affect spleen in ~70%; liver abscesses occur in 30-79% per HPO. Associated inflammatory bowel disease is separate.
Benign tumor arising in the peritoneum, assigned to the gastrointestinal axis as abdominal serosal disease.
Retinol transport disorder causing retinal dystrophy and iris abnormalities; comedonal acne and follicular hyperkeratosis occurred in 2/2 patients.
Congenital structural weakness and collapse of the trachea; associated cardiac and esophageal abnormalities are minority findings.
Inborn coenzyme A metabolism disorder causing brain degeneration and axonal neuropathy; distal wasting reflects denervation rather than primary muscle disease.
Skeletal dysplasia defined by epiphyseal stippling and limb abnormalities; skin changes and cataracts lack evidence of >=30% prevalence across this group.
Copper transport defect with skeletal dysplasia; neurodevelopmental impairment and bladder diverticula each 4/4. Skin, GI, vascular and hepatic features omitted by cap.
Aldosterone synthesis deficiency causes salt wasting, hyperkalemia and hyponatremia; renal salt loss reflects hormone deficiency rather than intrinsic kidney disease.
Malignant tumor arising from ovarian germ cells; reproductive tumor without a defined endocrine disorder or other qualifying organ involvement.
Benign adipocytic tumor typically arising in subcutaneous tissue.
Cobalamin metabolism defect defined by megaloblastic anemia and neurodevelopmental injury; retinal/optic damage 30-79%. Renal and oral disease omitted by cap.
Neurodevelopmental syndrome; hepatic failure, renal hypoplasia and cardiac/vascular abnormalities each reported in 1/3. Ocular and skeletal findings omitted by cap.
Obesity caused by impaired hypothalamic energy regulation; antecedent hypothalamic injury is a cause rather than additional damage produced by obesity.
Immune-mediated inflammation damages cutaneous blood vessels and skin; systemic vasculitis occurs in a minority.
Phytanic acid metabolism disorder; retinitis pigmentosa >90%, neuropathy/anosmia >50% and hearing loss ~60%. Ichthyosis and cardiomyopathy are less common.
Congenital localized overgrowth of the fingers involving their skeletal and associated soft tissues.
Benign tumor of breast ducts; breast has no axis.
Benign adipose tumor arising within the kidney or renal capsule.
Inherited cardiac valve dysplasia with stenosis, regurgitation and associated great-vessel abnormalities; all fall within the cardiovascular axis.
Umbrella for bacterial infections of skin; additional organ damage is not shared by most subtypes.
Defined by conduction disease, dilated cardiomyopathy and digital skeletal malformations; primary myopathy occurs in only 1/14.
Primary skeletal dysplasia; airway cartilage calcification alone does not establish functional damage. Cord compression and respiratory injury lack >=30% evidence.
Congenital lymphatic vascular malformation causing persistent lower-limb lymphedema; edema-related nail changes do not establish additional skin damage.
Henipavirus infection with characteristic encephalitis and respiratory disease, including progressive respiratory failure.
